evidence: Frozen scoring.toml:1-11 has exactly render/constraints gates at 0.0, functional/polish/visual shares 0.6/0.2/0.2, and functional floor 0.05; it equals the frozen template policy. All five judges occupy the required gates or scored directories. Each judge header at lines 1-12 includes batched mode, positive timeout, boolean isolated, prompt.md, claude-code fallback and the exact template Playwright MCP declaration; there are no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/dimension-weight overrides. Functional judge.toml:14-18 alone declares verifier stdio, /usr/local/bin/python3, /tests/tools/restart_mcp.py and literal $APP_RESTART_HELPER. test.sh:127-193 generates/chmods/exports that helper before suites (213 and 224); restart_mcp.py:9,14,35 consumes the argument and exposes restart_app. Functional prompt.md:23,431 calls it once. Local tomllib assertions checked every criterion: 1 Render binary, 1 Constraints binary, 80 Functional binary, 6 Polish binary, 6 Visual likert points=5, with nonempty IDs/names/descriptions, unique per-file IDs and positive finite weights. Gates use all_pass and scored dimensions weighted_mean. Every prompt.md resolves relative to its judge file and contains exactly one {app_context} and {criteria}; test.sh:198-200 context replacement was reproduced only in memory and retained the criteria slot (Render:22; Constraints:35; Functional:484; Polish:53; Visual:59). Frozen judge headers/aggregations equal the template. The local structural assertions and 20 deliberately malformed in-memory fixtures completed successfully: removing Playwright, duplicating an ID, zeroing a weight, or removing the criteria slot was rejected for each dimension. Frozen task/rules and current review policy match the manifest; all 60 indexed artifact hashes match. Adversarial thought experiment: a literal-copy playground with localStorage-only saves is structurally scoreable but cannot legitimately pass the Render computed-result bar (gates/render/judge.toml:26) and independent-context Constraints bar (gates/constraints/judge.toml:28). A conforming implementation with different labels, selectors or server-rendered library data is accepted by the gate instructions and needs no different scoring/MCP wiring. These are source-based counterexamples, not executed app grades. Evidence: per-row-review/evidence/24/structural_review.py, structural-review.json, structural-review.stdout.txt, workbook-enumeration.json and five context-injected prompts. This Pass concerns structural wiring only; private deterministic checkers, RewardKit execution, full judge duration and configured Oracle/model scores were not measured here and remain separate review obligations.
